server_status_values.ready: Account and required hardware were checked and are currently usable.
server_status_values.running: A training session currently owns the training lease on this server.
server_status_values.out_of_quota: Provider quota is exhausted or the configured quota threshold was reached.
server_status_values.kicked_out: The most recent session was terminated unexpectedly; retry only after cooldown.
server_status_values.unavailable_until: Manually or automatically marked unavailable until the recorded timestamp.
server_status_values.unknown: Not checked yet, or the provider does not expose enough information to verify availability.

servers.name: GitHub Actions CPU Fallback

limits.quota_notes: This public repository can use standard GitHub-hosted runners free and unlimited. ubuntu-latest is documented as 4 CPUs, 16 GB RAM and 14 GB SSD; each job has a 6-hour execution limit. These are published baselines, not a guarantee of future runner availability. Avoid storing checkpoints as Actions artifacts; use configured checkpoint storage.

start_steps: Open the repository Actions tab and select the ULTRON CPU training workflow.
For a guided start, press Run workflow.
The switcher may trigger this workflow through the official workflow_dispatch event after quota, cooldown and lease checks.
The worker resumes from the newest committed and verified cloud checkpoint.
servers.status_reason: Primary free CPU training provider; owner-triggered launch through GitHub Actions.

servers.name: Google Colab Free

limits.quota_notes: Free GPU access is not guaranteed. Hardware and usage limits are dynamic and not published as fixed quotas. Free notebooks can run for at most 12 hours depending on availability and usage patterns. Google disallows remote control or bypassing the notebook UI on managed free runtimes.

start_steps: Open the repository's train.ipynb through the Colab GitHub link.
Choose Runtime > Change runtime type and select a free GPU if one is offered.
Add Supabase credentials through Colab Secrets, never notebook cells.
Press Runtime > Run all; if no GPU is offered, the notebook uses CPU settings.
servers.status_reason: Free GPU allocation and account usage limits are dynamic and cannot be determined from public documentation.
servers.remote_control_reason: Google Colab's managed free runtimes disallow remote control or bypassing the notebook UI; use Colab manually in its notebook interface.
